orderConfirmed.title: Order Confirmed
orderConfirmed.content: Your order {orderNo} has been confirmed and is being prepared.

orderCancelled.title: Order Cancelled
orderCancelled.content: Your order {orderNo} has been cancelled. Reason: {reason}

orderDelivered.title: Order Delivered
orderDelivered.content: Your order {orderNo} has been delivered. Enjoy!

taskAssigned.title: New Delivery Task
taskAssigned.content: You have a new delivery task. Order: {orderNo}. Please accept it in the tasks page.

taskFailed.title: Task Cancelled
taskFailed.content: Delivery task for order {orderNo} has been cancelled.

settlementConfirmed.title: Settlement Confirmed
settlementConfirmed.content: Your settlement {settlementId} of ${amount} has been confirmed and added to your balance.

retentionWinback.title: We miss you!
retentionWinback.content: It has been a while since your last order. Here is a coupon for your next visit!

firstPurchaseNudge.title: Place your first order
firstPurchaseNudge.content: Welcome! New customers get a special coupon on their first order.

repurchaseThanks.title: Thank you for your loyalty
repurchaseThanks.content: Thanks for your {orderNo} — another order completed. We would love your review!

birthdayGreeting.title: Happy Birthday!
birthdayGreeting.content: Wishing you a wonderful birthday. A gift coupon is waiting for you!

replenishReminder.title: Time to restock
replenishReminder.content: Your subscribed product may be running low. Reorder in one tap.

cartRecall.title: Your cart is waiting
cartRecall.content: You left items in your cart. Come back and complete your order!

autoReplenishDue.title: Time to reorder
autoReplenishDue.content: The product you regularly buy is likely due. Reorder in one tap.

priceDropAlert.title: Price dropped!
priceDropAlert.content: A product on your price watch list has dropped. Check it out!

restockAlert.title: Back in stock
restockAlert.content: A product on your restock watch list is available again.

viewNudge.title: Still thinking it over?
viewNudge.content: You viewed this product a few days ago. It might be just what you need.

outOfStock.title: Item Out of Stock
outOfStock.content: Some items in your order {orderNo} are out of stock: {items}. Tap to view details.

outOfStockCancelled.title: Order Cancelled - Items Out of Stock
outOfStockCancelled.content: All items in your order {orderNo} are out of stock ({items}). The order has been cancelled and will be refunded automatically.

outOfStockAutoRefunded.title: Refund Completed
outOfStockAutoRefunded.content: Your order {orderNo} items were out of stock. A refund of ${amount} has been automatically issued. If you disagree, you can dispute it in the order details.

outOfStockRefundPending.title: Refund Being Processed
outOfStockRefundPending.content: Some items in your order {orderNo} were out of stock. Your refund of ${amount} is being processed and will arrive after review.

outOfStockSuggestion.title: Replacement Suggestion
outOfStockSuggestion.content: An item in your order {orderNo} is out of stock. A replacement is suggested: {items}. Tap to confirm or decline.

outOfStockSuggestionExpired.title: Replacement Expired
outOfStockSuggestionExpired.content: You did not respond to the replacement suggestion for order {orderNo} in time. The out-of-stock item will be refunded automatically.

ticketCreated.title: Issue Ticket Created
ticketCreated.content: An issue ticket {ticketNo} has been created for your order {orderNo}. Our support team will follow up.
